body: As I watched, the stranger continued their camera clicks unflinching. Their posture was rigid, focused on every detail in the background as if they were cataloguing it for some grand purpose. The sun hung low, casting long shadows across the cobblestones. My instinct urged me not to intrude, but my heart thumped against my chest with a fierce protectiveness. I noticed how the warm glow of the setting sun cast uneven lights across the scene, making everything look almost magical in its simplicity. I took a deep breath, feeling the familiar strength rising within me—strength not just to protect myself from harm, but also to guide this person back to safety without drawing attention to myself.
